name: Bucket Protocol BUCK
oneLiner: BUCK is Bucket Protocol's overcollateralized Sui-native dollar stablecoin minted from SUI, BTC, ETH, and LSTs through CDP vaults with PSM stablecoin swaps.
collateral: SUI, BTC, ETH, and LSTs via CDPs; USDC/USDT via Peg Stability Module
pegMechanism: Overcollateralized CDPs with per-asset minimum collateral ratios (e.g. 110% for SUI); hard peg via direct BUCK redemption for collateral with dynamic redemption fee; soft peg via PSM enabling 1:1 swaps with USDC/USDT; liquidations via Tank module

oracleRisk.summary: Bucket's oracle repo aggregates Switchboard, Pyth, and Supra feeds with freshness and tolerance checks for BUCK collateral pricing, without documented shutdown handling.

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Resolved from Pharos stablecoin metadata by the blacklistability resolver through parent, reserve, custody, variant, or text-signal exposure; no separate manual override source is attached.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Inferred review retained: BUCK resolves to Upstream because existing dependency, reserve, custody, variant, or text metadata links exposure to a freezable upstream asset.

mintAuthority.summary: BUCK is minted through Bucket Protocol CDP/PSM functions on Sui. The BUCK TreasuryCap is locked inside the shared BucketProtocol object. Admin caps are held by EOA 0x169451… and the package UpgradeCap (policy=0, v27) by EOA 0x938884…, both confirmed Bucket Protocol team operational wallets.

controls.label: BucketProtocol shared object holding BUCK TreasuryCap
controls.capDescription: BUCK TreasuryCap is wrapped inside the shared BucketProtocol object; user minting is bounded by Bucket CDP/PSM module logic, while separate admin and package-upgrade controls can change parameters or code.
controls.evidence: Sui object read returned shared BucketProtocol object version 891923356 with buck_treasury_cap id 0x058715d59eda37c2a1880a3c0972878f4448f48f2ffe8ee43cff7ace6afabcd4 and total_supply 25970988996231740. Normalized module exposes borrow, repay, redeem, flash_borrow_buck, flash_repay_buck, and admin update functions.

controls.label: Bucket admin cap owner (EOA)
controls.evidence: At Sui checkpoint 285785957, sui_getObject for 0x169451… returned error notExists confirming this is a Sui address (EOA, not a smart contract). suix_getOwnedObjects confirms it holds BktAdminCap 0x99a8a7…, AdminCap 0xfa5775…, and 2 UpgradeCaps alongside NFT/token assets typical of an operational team wallet.

controls.label: Bucket package upgrade-cap owner (EOA)
controls.evidence: At Sui checkpoint 285785957, sui_getObject for 0x938884… returned error notExists confirming this is a Sui address (EOA). suix_getOwnedObjects confirms it holds 19+ UpgradeCaps including BUCK UpgradeCap 0x332cc625… (policy=0, version=27, current package 0x346684e4…). Policy=0 means full upgrades are possible. The high version count (27 upgrades) confirms this is an actively used deployer wallet.

review.evidence: At Sui checkpoint 285785957: BucketProtocol shared object 0x9e3dab… confirmed to hold buck_treasury_cap (TreasuryCap wrapped inside as a complex field) along with version=7 and min_bottle_size. Both admin addresses (0x169451… and 0x938884…) confirmed as EOAs via notExists object checks. 0x169451… holds AdminCap/BktAdminCap. 0x938884… holds UpgradeCap (policy=0, v27) — both are expected operational team wallets for a Sui CDP protocol. TreasuryCap locked inside the shared BucketProtocol object, not directly accessible.
